channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Advisory · Dallam, Hartley, Oldham
item.description: Flood Advisory issued October 25 at 6:41PM CDT until October 25 at 9:45PM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX. In effect until Oct 25, 9:45 PM CT. Areas: Dallam, Hartley, Oldham. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
